name: philipperemy/FX-1-Minute-Data
what_it_holds: Apache-2.0 repo (683 stars, updated 10 Sep 2026) titled HISTDATA: a simple downloader/API plus multi-year committed sample data for 1-minute (and tick-level) historical FX pairs, crude oil, and stock indices, sourced from HistData.com.
why_useful: We currently hold only FX 'schedules' per CONTEXT.md; this is a finer-grained (1-minute), multi-year, easy one-command-pull historical FX series that could sharpen intra-quarter FX-mix timing for the ADR ex-FX/FX split, more granular than daily FRED FX series already held.
time_coverage: multi-year historical, 1-minute bars, up to date per README
size_hint: downloader + example data; full history pulled via included tool (potentially large)
duplicate_of_holding: extends the FX schedules already held to intraday/1-minute granularity
themes: wildcard: an Airbnb superhost / small property manager who uses open-s
why_all: We currently hold only FX 'schedules' per CONTEXT.md; this is a finer-grained (1-minute), multi-year, easy one-command-pull historical FX series that could sharpen intra-quarter FX-mix timing for the ADR ex-FX/FX split, more granular than daily FRED FX series already held.

name: cyanheads/exchange-rates-mcp-server
what_it_holds: MCP server (STDIO/HTTP) for currency conversion, FX rates, and querying historical ECB exchange-rate data. Apache-2.0. Actively updated (12 Sep 2026).
why_useful: Alternative machine-callable historical ECB FX puller (could be dropped into an agent tool chain instead of hand-rolling XML parsing); marginal beyond the plain client above but notable as a maintained, typed access layer with explicit 'historical' query support.
time_coverage: historical ECB range (1999-present per ECB feed)
duplicate_of_holding: Overlaps with AllRates-Today client above; flagged as an alternative tool, not new data.
themes: FX and purchasing power: exchange-rate history (ECB, BIS, FRED), broad-dollar indices, PPP/Big Mac, tourist affordability indices, company FX-exposure tooling
why_all: Alternative machine-callable historical ECB FX puller (could be dropped into an agent tool chain instead of hand-rolling XML parsing); marginal beyond the plain client above but notable as a maintained, typed access layer with explicit 'historical' query support.

name: dillonsnyman1/fx-exposure-hedging-dashboard
what_it_holds: Dashboard/tool that calculates FX portfolio exposure, models forward hedging via covered interest rate parity, computes currency-level VaR and hedge effectiveness. No committed historical dataset found (student/portfolio project, 0 stars, updated Jul 2026); needs its own rate inputs.
why_useful: Could serve as a template/regression method for estimating how much of ABNB's revenue/EBITDA translation exposure to EUR/GBP/etc. is hedge-able or historically has moved with spot, i.e. an FX-exposure regression tool as hinted in the task's keywords. Not a data source itself.
themes: FX and purchasing power: exchange-rate history (ECB, BIS, FRED), broad-dollar indices, PPP/Big Mac, tourist affordability indices, company FX-exposure tooling

name: greven/forex
what_it_holds: Elixir library for ECB exchange rates, MIT licensed, actively updated (10 Sep 2026). Wraps the same ECB daily feed as other clients; no separate stored dataset.
why_useful: Marginal alternative client to the ECB feed; listed for completeness of the 'method' landscape, not because it adds new data beyond what ECB itself and other clients already expose.
duplicate_of_holding: Duplicate of AllRates-Today client in function; different language binding only.
